title: SelCal: selection-aware calibration of scanned-lag dependence tests

creators.name: Liang, Bingbing
creators.affiliation: School of AI Engineering, Guangzhou College of Technology and Business, Guangzhou, China

description:
SelCal tests lagged dependence between two time series when the lag is chosen by scanning a pre-declared set of candidate lags. It repeats the complete lag search inside every circular-shift surrogate, can enumerate the whole circular group exactly (null circular_shift_exact_v1), refuses plans whose smallest attainable p-value exceeds alpha (for a lagged-Pearson scan of L lags over the complete circular group the exact p-value cannot fall below L/n), and keeps verifiable, replayable records. Command-line workflow: selcal validate, run, verify --replay, report.

This record holds the software, product tests, documentation and examples. Release 0.1.2 corrects the scientific-assumption advisory printed by selcal validate, the report and the interface, ships the exact-enumeration example of the software paper and a paper-to-evidence manifest (docs/paper/selcal_softwarex_manifest.json); the calibration code is that of 0.1.1. The protocols (frozen before execution), synthetic inputs, per-run results and test receipts behind the accompanying software paper are archived separately at 10.5281/zenodo.23332143 (CC BY 4.0). The method credited is the tailored-lag circular-shift test (Cannistra et al., eLife Reviewed Preprint 2025; Yuan and Shou, PLoS Biology 2024).
